totpFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
totpFactor.description: Ask for a code from your authenticator app, as well as your password, every time you sign in.

status.recoveryRemaining: {count} recovery code left | {count} recovery codes left
status.recoveryNone: No recovery codes left. Generate a new set before you lose access to your authenticator app.
status.recoveryLow: You're running low on recovery codes. Generate a new set.
status.pending: Setup started and waiting for a code. It expires at {time}.

unavailable.notLocal: Two-factor authentication is only available for local accounts signed in with a password. If this is one, sign out and sign in again.
unavailable.httpsRequired: Two-factor setup needs HTTPS. Open Drydock over HTTPS, or ask an administrator to set DD_AUTH_TOTP_ALLOWHTTP=true if the network is trusted.
unavailable.noKeyRing: Two-factor setup isn't available on this server. An administrator needs to configure an encryption key ring first.
unavailable.recoverySession: You signed in with a recovery code, so this action isn't allowed. Sign in with a code from your authenticator app.

heading.replace: Confirm it's you to replace your authenticator
heading.regenerate: Confirm it's you to get new recovery codes
heading.remove: Confirm it's you to turn off two-factor

reauth.hint: Enter your password. Nothing is kept after this step.
reauth.hintWithCode: Enter your password and a current code. Nothing is kept after this step.

scan.heading: Scan with your authenticator app
scan.instructions: Open your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
scan.replaceNote: Your current authenticator keeps working until you confirm the new one.
scan.qrLabel: QR code for setting up two-step verification
scan.qrFailed: The QR code couldn't be drawn. Enter the setup key instead.
scan.secretLabel: Can't scan? Enter this setup key
scan.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

codes.heading: Save your recovery codes
codes.description: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator app. This is the only time they are shown.

remove.message: Sign-in will need only your password again, and your other sessions will end.

notice.regenerated: Your new recovery codes are active. The old ones no longer work.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.reauthFailed: That password or code didn't match. Check them and try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {time}.
errors.lockedLater: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.busy: Another check is still running. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalidRequest: Enter your password and a valid code.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
errors.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.enrollmentGone: This setup was closed after too many wrong codes. Start again.
errors.stateChanged: Two-factor settings changed somewhere else. Review them and try again.
